I notice this sometimes but usually it's only the first couple of posts that are duplicates from the previous page.

I think this has to do with switching pages serving as a refresh of sorts, so if posts have changed states while you were on the first page, by the time you go to page 2 those posts may now actually be on page 2.

For instance, if you open page 1 and take the time to view every post, by the time you get to the bottom several minutes may have passed, during which time other posts may have made it to the front page. Thus, when you go to page 2, posts that were previously on page 1 are now on page 2, and you see them again.

I don't think this is really a bug; more like a consequence of the times that Voat updates page states and the way the sorting algorithms work.

I recommend that before you switch pages, you first refresh the page you are on. You might find new pages you have not read yet. Do this until you've read every post, and then switch pages. This will probably minimize the duplicates you see.
